name: Jiangsu Jingxue Insulation Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Jingxue Insulation Technology Co., Ltd. is a Chinese company focused on the research, development, design, manufacturing, and sales of energy-efficient thermal insulation materials specifically for industrial building envelope systems within China. Their product line includes a range of cold storage insulation panels, such as sandwich panels, PIR/PUR clean boards, inner partition panels, and standard cold storage boards. They also supply industrial and cold storage doors, alongside various energy-saving building plates. These products find extensive application in cold storage enclosure systems across numerous sectors, including cold chain logistics, food processing, retail (e.g., shopping malls and supermarkets), hospitality (e.g., hotels and aviation catering), biopharmaceuticals, fine chemicals, and precision electronics. Furthermore, the company provides comprehensive services encompassing the design, production, installation, and maintenance of complete cold storage enclosure systems. Founded in 1993, Jiangsu Jingxue Insulation Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Changzhou, China.
